knownLimitations: Phase 12B Makeup Semantic Extraction Baseline is candidate-only; it is not final recognition, not AI-confirmed extraction, not product shade matching, not medical or skin diagnosis, and not fully automatic high-quality makeup extraction.

Phase 12B semantic candidates require human review and cannot mutate UserAppTemplatePackage, write registry state, publish, create a production writer, replace the current User App Shell package, upload real photos, store real user data, enter training datasets, or resume Phase 10V.

Phase 12C semantic candidate draft integration and human review editing are draft-only and operator-only; accepted candidates are not final recognition, registry readiness, publication, production writer output, UserAppTemplatePackage mutation, or User App Shell package replacement.

Phase 12D Photo-to-Template Operator Workflow & Draft Preview QA is operator-only and draft-preview-only; it is not final recognition, AI-confirmed extraction, fully automatic extraction, registry readiness, publish readiness, production readiness, production writer output, UserAppTemplatePackage mutation, or User App Shell package replacement.
Phase 12D Draft Preview QA must keep sourceType, confidenceBand, evidence, limitations, reviewerDecision, reviewer notes, humanReviewRequired, and notFinal hidden from the ordinary User App path.
